assumptions: CLI route `--metric nlpd` -> crates/nlpd score_rgb_u8 (lib.rs:52-79): deinterleave u8->3x f32 planes then score_planes (lib.rs:138-207), maps=None (score path, not score_rgb_u8_maps). Requires min(W,H) >= 96 (lib.rs:209-217).

LEVELS = 6 (lib.rs:135). Per level l, per channel c, per image: level_transform (lib.rs:718-749) = downsample -> fused normalize_filtered -> scratch.normalized plane. Level dims ceil(W/2^l) x ceil(H/2^l) (div_ceil chains, lib.rs:382-384, score_planes w.div_ceil(2)).

downsample (lib.rs:381-391): filter5_horizontal at stride 2 writes tmp_h[out_w*h] (full intermediate plane), then simd::filter5_vertical writes out[out_w*out_h]. The stride-2 horizontal path (filter5_horizontal_decimate, lib.rs:470-490) computes the FULL stride-1 conv G[j]=sum_k w_k*row[j+k] then keeps G[2ox-pad] -> ~2x the taps per output element; that overcompute is intrinsic here (it is the production path, not optional).

simd::normalize_filtered (simd.rs:390-614) runs upsample -> 5-tap H conv -> 5-tap V smooth -> lap (original - smooth) -> divisive normalize as ONE row-ring pass: neither up nor H nor smooth nor a materialized lap plane exists; rings hold 5 h-rows + 3 lap-rows of uw width -> materialize strip. On the RGB path uw==w, uh==h (identity crop map, simd.rs:406-414).

Per out el of the fused chain: bilinear lerp (x0/x1/tx tables, ~4 ld + 2 fma + 1 mul), h5 conv (5 fma + 5 ld into ring row), v5 smooth (5 fma + 5 ld), lap = orig - smooth (1 ld + 1 add + ld smooth already counted), normalize denom = sigma + sum4 w_k*|lap_neighbor| (4 abs + 4 fma) + 1 div + store.
squared_difference (simd.rs:4-21) folds (a-b)^2 into f64 per channel per level; maps path (score_rgb_u8_maps) NOT counted - CLI score path passes maps=None.
Level-5 downsample produces level-6 planes that score_planes drops unused (small implementation overcompute, ~1/4^5 of the downsample stage) - noted, kept intrinsic.
Laparra 0.6-norm aggregation: rms=sqrt(ss/(w*h*3)), weighted_sum += rms^0.6 per level, final ^(1/0.6) - scalar per level.

stages.name: RGB8 -> 3 planar f32 in [0,1]
stages.notes: u8->f32/255 fused into planar deinterleave; no interleaved f32 copies (lib.rs:69-70).

stages.name: 5-tap lowpass horizontal + stride-2 decimate (full conv then subsample)
stages.notes: Decimate path computes stride-1 conv at every interior j then takes even outputs (lib.rs:472-490): 2x taps/output counted. Writes tmp_h[out_w*h] full plane scratch.

stages.name: 5-tap lowpass vertical + stride-2 decimate
stages.notes: Direct 5-tap on tmp_h (out_w x h) -> low[out_w*out_h]. Low plane feeds both the fused lap/norm at THIS level and the next level's planes.

stages.name: fused ring: bilinear up + h5 + v5 smooth + lap + divisive normalize
stages.notes: Row-ring fusion (simd.rs:414-480): per output row, 3 lap rows materialized from ring of 5 h-rows, each filtered off freshly lerped up rows; up/H/smooth/lap planes never exist (strip). Denominator uses 4-reflect lap neighbors + sigma (DN[level], SIGMAS[level]). Output written to level-0 slab subregion (full extent of this level).

stages.name: per-channel squared-difference f64 fold
stages.notes: sum((a-b)^2) over 3 channels per level; feeds rms=(ss/(w*h*3))^0.5 weighted by ^0.6.
